Items v4 box audit

Every frozen v4 redaction is traced back to its earlier and later PDF pages. The CV detector sees one page at a time and does not receive answers, OCR, document IDs, paired-release pixels, or benchmark labels. Saved v4 text is located as exact word boxes in the later PDF text layer and attached afterward to measure geometric coverage.

Interpretation. Full means every page fragment of an item achieved at least 80% exact target-word-center coverage. Partial means at least one fragment had meaningful coverage but the complete item did not pass. A geometry miss is not proof that the v4 text is wrong; open the paired scans to distinguish detector, text-localization, and scan-registration failures.
